label: Initiation and consecution
subgoals: Check that every initial state lies in P
Check that every transition from a P-state lands in P
Conclude that P is an inductive invariant when both checks pass

label: Invariant versus inductive
subgoals: Test whether all of them satisfy P
Classify P as inductive, failing initiation, invariant but not inductive, or not invariant

label: Reading the four outcomes
subgoals: Treat failed initiation as a reset or property error
Treat a reachable violation as a real bug with a BMC trace
Treat an unreachable CTI as a call to strengthen the property
